title: Tentacle Forest
paragraphs: “So? What exactly happened with this Magical Hazard?”
“We can’t explain the details very well. The person in charge will explain everything on-site.”
“So, it’s a situation where someone who doesn’t fully understand what’s happening can’t give a sufficient explanation.”
“Got it. Since it’s a monster research facility… could it be Rat’s place? If something happened there… I’ve got a bad feeling about this.”

Father scratched his head in frustration. We immediately mounted the Filolials and set off. Eventually, we arrived at the research facility, which was being slowly consumed by overgrown vegetation. This is strange. Even if it’s some kind of abnormality with the Bio Plant, the one I gave to the researcher had all potential dangers eliminated.
And what’s this? The vines aren’t green but more of a flesh-like color.
“Ah, Rat-san!”
Father spotted the researcher, who had evacuated, and dismounted from Sakura-chan to approach her. She seems to be safe.
“It’s been a while… or has it? Shield Hero-san.”
“I guess it has. So… what happened here? What’s the damage?”
In response to Father’s question, the researcher looked at the forest of flesh-colored tentacles with an exhausted expression. Hmm, judging by her reaction, she doesn’t seem to be the culprit.

“It’s the remnants of the Homunculus Research Institute. They blamed me for their department being shut down and took out their frustration by tampering with the plants borrowed from the heroes, which were supposed to be under strict supervision.”
“Huh? So this is the Bio Plant Motoyasu-kun was talking about?”
“This seems strange. That was a plant. It might turn purple, but it wouldn’t turn into this flesh color.”
“That’s the tricky part. Apparently, those guys from the Homunculus Research Institute forcibly mixed all kinds of chemicals and even incorporated homunculus elements into it.”
“So… basically, it started as a Bio Plant, but after all those modifications, it turned into a homunculus monster?”
“Most likely.”
The researcher let out a sigh.
“Security was lax.”
Ren commented sarcastically. That being said, I agree with Ren.
“It was strictly secured. This wouldn’t have happened without an insider.”
“Should we consider this another case of Takt’s faction causing trouble?”
“They’re as troublesome as the Three Heroes Church.”
“Well, they occupied my research facility and declared that the Four Holy Heroes were wrong, but it seems they were attacked by their own runaway experiment.”
“Wow…”
This is an unmanageable mess. And it seems their influence is gradually spreading.
“What happened to the monsters from your place, Rat-san?”
“I released them right after the incident. They’re lying low somewhere else for now. As for Mi-kun… I immediately evacuated him to a capsule.”
“So, what should we do? Should we just blow it all away?”
“I’d prefer if you didn’t, considering all the chemicals around. If it mutates any further, that would be…”
How troublesome.
Should I just ignore the researcher’s instructions and blast it away like last time?
“Wasn’t there a herbicide recipe among the chemicals? What if we used that?”
“It’s no longer really a plant, so I wouldn’t expect much effect. But it’s better than doing nothing.”
“In that case, we’d have to find the main body somewhere and destroy it… if it exists.”
“That would be ideal… By the way, before the heroes arrived, some researchers went in to investigate…”

The researcher took out a crystal of vision. Then, she showed us the projected footage. What we saw was a cramped space filled with what seemed to be people, their bodies fused with tentacles, groaning in agony.
“Eek…”
Itsuki let out a small scream.
“W-What is this!?”
“I’ve seen something like this in an old game, but… this is…”
“Is this what they call a breeding ground!?”

“After recording this footage, the researchers, fearing for their lives, all returned. Their bodies were partially deformed. Even the slightest touch is fatal. The mutations are extreme, and it’s uncertain when it might start spreading explosively by scattering spores or seeds.”
The researcher pointed toward the temporary tent. Since Father is the expert in treatment, Ren and Itsuki pushed him forward to take a look inside.
“Whoa…”
Even Father’s voice went up an octave in surprise.
“This was recorded a few hours ago. Until then, I could hear the groaning, but now even that’s stopped. The chances of finding survivors are grim…”
This thing has evolved into something far more malicious than the original. It no longer retains any trace of the original Bio Plant.
“F-For now, give the Yggdrasil potion to the ones who are still okay… quickly.”
Following Father’s instructions, the soldiers promptly brought the medicine. They were well-prepared. A soft light filled the tent, and voices of relief echoed from within.
“Ah… looks like they were able to cure them.”
In contrast, the researcher looked slightly disappointed.
“Is there a problem if they can be cured?”
“For various reasons. The department was ultimately disbanded, but there are quite a few people who haven’t been recognized as part of Takt’s faction. If they accuse us of letting them die…”
“The people shown in that footage… that’s just the beginning, right? Are you saying we have to save them all!?”
“Even if we wait for the king’s decision, he’s asleep right now, isn’t he? If we wait for him to wake up, how much worse will the situation get?”
“…We have to act to prevent further damage.”
“Exactly. However, physical attacks will trigger chemical reactions. Herbicides have little effect. That leaves magic, I suppose?”
“That would be ideal. However, ritual magic was used for suppression before, but it wasn’t very effective. Its magic defense is quite formidable.”
The researcher’s analytical skills seem impressive. As expected of Filo-tan’s researcher.

“Also… for now, it’s based on human tissue, but depending on the area, it’s starting to take on the characteristics of monsters. I wonder how many hours it will be before it breaks free and starts moving on its own.”
“Then, shall I incinerate it with magic?”
If it’s just a building of that size, I can reduce it to ashes in an instant with my magic.
“By incinerating, you mean fire, right? If possible, I’d like multiple types of magic cast continuously.”
“Is there a reason for that?”
“With this level of mutation, any area with high fire resistance will survive and accelerate its growth.”
“Like how viruses develop resistance to antibiotics?”
“So, Motoyasu is a given, but Itsuki and I will have to join in as well…”

Father can’t use offensive magic. This puts him at a slight disadvantage in situations like this. Still, after coming to this world and learning about magic, Father and the others have picked up the basics to a certain extent. With the help of my dear Filo-tan, their mastery is progressing smoothly. However, they’ve yet to reach the point of chanting Liberation. They’ve managed to learn Energy Boost, so they’re almost there. Itsuki is lagging behind slightly, though.
“Do you think Drypher will be enough?”
“Wait, isn’t there a magic expert here?”
Father spoke as if he had an idea.
“I’ll hurry back here, so let’s use someone’s portal to go to Melromarc.”
“Ah, I see! You’re going to ask the Queen of Melromarc for help.”
“In terms of using composite attributes, the Seven Star Weapon of the staff should make it easier.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded repeatedly. Thus, we used a portal to teleport to Melromarc to meet with the Queen. However, the Queen was out, which caused a slight delay.
“I apologize. I was also acting for the sake of the world…”
The Queen apologized, but considering that we had shown up unannounced, it was we who were being rude. It would be remarkable if anyone could have predicted the situation unfolding in Faubrey.
“No, no, Your Majesty, you’ve done nothing wrong.”
“Indeed. For now, aside from Naofumi, the other heroes and those skilled in magic will unite and unleash magic at that research facility.”
“Hopefully, this works…”
“We have no choice but to try.”
“Honestly… those former Whip Hero followers never do anything good.”
What a hassle… I should have asked how Father and his group in the original world dealt with these kinds of problems.
Isn’t there some way to take it down in one shot?
“Al Drypher Magic Boost X!”

Oh, this is the first time I’ve heard Father cast a support spell like this. A gentle wave of support magic washed over us. When I checked the status, I saw that a large boost had been applied to the magic stat.
